messages:
lee: launching an incremental index build on invoices to help geo filters. Window 01:00-01:20 UTC. Will pin api-server=release-2026-03-08 for the push. Doing CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_invoices_region ON invoices ((json_meta->>'region')) WHERE (status='paid');
deploybot: Canary started: indexer v0.9 on shard db-east-2. Holdpoint after first 100 rows. Health hooks enabled.
nora: ack. i'll keep an eye on replica lag and wal_write time.
infra-bot: preflight: free_buffers 12GB, checkpoint_timeout 5min, avg_wal_sync 12ms. Baseline p95 write 120ms, replicas healthy.
sam: canary progressed to 100 rows, no locks >300ms. moving to batch mode at 400/s. Auto-abort thresholds: replica_lag>25s or i/o saturation >70%
# ~4m later~
infra-bot: observing increasing wal_activity and a brief checkpoint flood on primary; iowait 48%. Replica lag db-east-2-replica now 18s and climbing.
lee: holdpoint pause batch. @deploybot throttle indexer to 50/s and re-evaluate. Keep pin.
deploybot: Throttle applied: new rate 50/s. Next health snapshot in 3m.
# ~6m later~
sam: lag continues to climb to 28s; clients reported a handful of 503s hitting the API gateway. This is edging our SLA.
nora: i'm seeing heap_growth on primary due to many small writes causing temp table churn during index updates. Not seeing blocking locks but writes are degrading.
lee: decision: abort canary and remove partial index on canary shard. We will not DROP INDEX cluster-wide yet; just stop the job and clear index artifacts on canary. Schedule full rollback if any downstream errors. Nora, prepare cleanup steps.
nora: cleanup plan: stop indexer jobs, run VACUUM on affected ranges, then DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_invoices_region on shard db-east-2. I'll monitor wal queue.
deploybot: Stopping canary jobs and scheduling cleanup on db-east-2. Rollback initiated at ts=1758884700. Checkpoint saved chk_1758884700.
infra-bot: Post-rollback metrics (5m): iowait 9%, replica lag back to 1s, API 503s cleared. No SEV.
sam: confirmed baseline restored. Please add a follow-up ticket with suggested mitigations: pre-check for checkpoint storms, add WAL-pressure gate, and test smaller chunk sizes + preheated replicas.
lee: will do. Update release notes: canary aborted due to checkpoint-induced replica lag; reattempt planned with WAL-pressure gating and lower concurrency. INF-9922 created. Closing thread.
